pipeline_name: New Administration Capital PS Gas Pipeline

resolutions.researcher_notes: current_ref (petro-news.com/95212/) is live (200) but the site has since edited the article and DROPPED the paragraph describing this exact pipeline (item #23, 'خط تغذية محطة كهرباء العاصمة الإدارية') -- the live page keeps the item in its table-of-contents but the body text between items 22 and 24 is now missing, so the live URL no longer supports the value (a real 'link rot by edit', not a 404). Recovered the original paragraph via Wayback (snapshot 2024-11-12, close to the article's stated 2024-10-10 publish date): 'يأتي المشروع ضمن الخطة العاجلة لإمداد محطة كهرباء سيمينز بالغاز الطبيعي بإنشاء خط تغذية 32 بوصة وطول 63 كم، بتكلفة 327 مليون جنيه' -- exact match on diameter (32in), length (63km) and cost (EGP 327m), described in past/completed framing (state-implemented project, 'نفذتها الدولة'). Confirmed later Wayback snapshots (2025-03-28, 2025-12-06) and the current live page all show this paragraph already removed, so only the 2024-11-12 snapshot is usable. Status='operating' is not stated verbatim but is a safe inference: the line was purpose-built as an urgent gas feed for the New Administrative Capital (Siemens H-class) power station, which independent reporting (Al-Masry Al-Youm, 2019-04-03) confirms has been fully operational at 4,800 MW since 2018/2019 -- the plant cannot run without its gas feed(s). Two independent origins (Egyptian energy-trade outlet + national newspaper) but neither is a dedicated pipeline-commissioning notice, hence medium rather than high. Note for the record: do not confuse this 63km/32in/EGP327m line with two other, larger GEM/press-documented gas feeds to the same power station -- El Tina-Abu Sultan-New Administrative Capital (42in/165km/EGP3.335bn) and New Capital-Dahshur/Siemens (32in/70km/EGP605m); all three appear to be separate, non-duplicate segments serving the same plant, per the same petro-news project list.

Same underlying issue as the Status unit: current_ref (petro-news.com/95212/) is live but the specific paragraph with the cost figure has been edited out of the current article; recovered via Wayback snapshot 2024-11-12 (closest to the article's 2024-10-10 publish date), which reads 'بإنشاء خط تغذية 32 بوصة وطول 63 كم، بتكلفة 327 مليون جنيه' -- exact match for SegmentCost=327,000,000 and SegmentCostUnits=EGP. Could not find a second independent source citing this exact EGP327m/63km figure -- searches surfaced two similarly-worded but numerically distinct sibling projects feeding the same New Administrative Capital power station (32in/70km/EGP605m 'New Capital-Dahshur (Siemens)' line per presidency.eg/egy-map.com, and 42in/165km/EGP3.335bn El Tina-Abu Sultan-New Administrative Capital line) -- these are NOT corroboration for this row's value, they are distinct projects, flagged here only so a future researcher doesn't mistake one for a duplicate/contradiction of the other. Single-source (medium tier); no fabricated URL used -- if a second corroborating source is needed for 'high', it was not found despite a broad Arabic-language search (petro-news, presidency.eg, egy-map.com, sis.gov.eg, dostor.org, attaqa.net, almasryalyoum.com).
